verses.1: And he took Korah, son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, and Dinan and Abiram. They were sons of Eliav. And Ohn, son of Pelet, was one of the sons of Reuben.
verses.2: They stood before Moses. There were also fifty men from the people of Israel, along with their leaders and officials.
verses.3: And they gathered around Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “Be strong, for all the assembly is holy. In their midst is Jehovah. Therefore, you must take care not to offend Jehovah’s people.”
verses.4: And Moses heard this, and his face darkened.
verses.5: And he spoke to Korach and to all his followers, saying, “In the morning, God will know who it is that belongs to him. He will also know about the Holy One. Then he will offer up what he has chosen.”
verses.6: They did this. Take some ice and all its contents for yourselves.
verses.7: And they shall put fire on them, and they shall burn them before the LORD the next day. And the man whom Jehovah chooses will be the Holy One, Most High, son of Levi.
verses.8: And Moses said to Korach, “Listen, sons of Levi!”
verses.9: The rest of you, as Israel’s gods have distinguished you from the rest of Israel, they will demand that you offer yourselves to them as sacrifices. You must serve their worship and stand before their court to serve them.
verses.10: And they will come to you and to all your brothers, the children of Levi. They will also ask for help from you.
verses.11: Therefore, you and all your followers who are being persecuted by Jehovah, and Aaron—what is this that we are being punished for?
verses.12: And Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, “We will not go.”
verses.13: How we were brought up from the land of milk and grass, to be killed by those who live by the sea. May they also be destroyed!
verses.14: Even if we were to go to a land full of milk and grass, they would still not give us any land or fields to cultivate. The people who live there will surely be destroyed; we will never be able to settle there.
verses.15: And Moses cried out to the LORD, “Do not let them be taken captive! I have brought none of them back alive.” I did not want to harm any of them.
verses.16: And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers shall stand before the LORD. You and they shall be there, after Aaron.”
verses.17: And take one of their slaves, and offer them as an offering to Jehovah. Offer fifty of their slaves as offerings. And you and Aaron shall each take one slave as an offering.
verses.18: And they took someone from among their own people, set fire on them, and placed incense on them. Then Moses and Aaron stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.19: And he gathered all the members of the congregation at the entrance of the tent of the Lord. Then he saw the glory of the Lord before all the congregation.
verses.20: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.21: They separated themselves from this assembly, and ate them as food.
verses.22: And they fell before them, and said to the gods of the wind, “One man has sinned, and all the people are condemned.”
verses.23: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.24: And he said to the assembly, “They have come from all around to the tent of Korach Dathan and his warriors.”
verses.25: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram. The elders of Israel followed him.
verses.26: And he spoke to the council, saying, “Please destroy these evil people’s tents. Do not touch anything that belongs to them, so that they will not be destroyed in all their sins.”
verses.27: And they went up from the tent of Dathan. Their leaders and soldiers also came out from around them. Dathan’s leaders and soldiers stood at the entrance to their tent, along with their wives and children.
verses.28: And Moses said, “Know that Jehovah has sent me to do all these things, not out of my own will.”
verses.29: If all people die, then all people’s troubles will also be upon them. But the Lord, who sent me, will not allow that to happen.
verses.30: And if health is created by Yahweh, and the land opens its mouth to swallow them all, along with everything they have. Then living beings will descend from heaven, and you will know that these people have come to seek out Yahweh.
verses.31: And it was as if he had spoken all these words. Then the land beneath them was filled with light.
verses.32: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with their families and all the people who lived there. It also swallowed all the livestock as well.
verses.33: And they came down, along with all those living beings that belonged to them. The earth covered them, and they were destroyed by the crowd.
verses.34: And all of Israel who were around them tried to get rid of them, because they said, “Otherwise, the land will swallow us up.”
verses.35: And fire came from Jehovah, and it consumed the fifty and two men who were from the tribe of Caleb.
